blurb: Guests sail on comfortable catamarans through scenic waterways with opportunities to see dolphins and other wildlife. Tours include dolphin adventure sails, sunset sails, island exploration, and private charters. Trips depart daily from Cape Crossing Marina and accommodate small groups for an authentic sailing experience.

cancellation: COMPANY POLICY All passengers will need a ticket regardless of age or participation of activities Our staff and crew at Cocoa Beach Catamaran will strive to give you the best possible service and at the same time make every effort to insure your trip is both enjoyable and successful. Cocoa Beach Catamaran has a ZERO tolerance drug policy on all our vessels.
policies: If weather prevents safe operation, guests can reschedule or review options per cancellation policy
Safety and Comfort Don’t be concerned about rough weather or high seas.
We can enjoy catamaran cruising on almost any day regardless of weather conditions!
If illegal drugs are discovered onboard, the trip will be terminated immediately and return to the dock without a refund.
Cancellation & Weather Policy All trips are refundable until 5 days / 120 hours prior to departure.
Within 5 days of departure, trips are non-refundable unless Trip Protection was purchased at checkout.
The Trip Protection fee is non-refundable.
This includes cancellations due to cloudy skies, imperfect weather, travel delays, or a guest choosing not to attend.
